name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
description: Techlio architects and builds custom MCP servers that connect LLMs securely to your internal databases, SaaS APIs, CRMs, and proprietary workflows.
h1: MCP servers that connect AI *to your own systems.*
answer: The Model Context Protocol is an open standard that lets AI models use external tools and data through a common interface. Techlio builds custom MCP servers that expose your databases, APIs and workflows to assistants such as Claude in a controlled way, with authentication, permission checks and logging on every call.

builds.title: Custom MCP servers
builds.text: Servers that expose the specific actions and data your teams need, with typed inputs and clear descriptions the model can follow.

builds.title: Secure access
builds.text: Authentication, per-user permissions and audit logs, so the model can only do what the current user may do.

builds.title: Product integrations
builds.text: MCP endpoints for SaaS products, so your customers can use your platform from their own AI assistant.

fits: You want an AI assistant to read from or act on internal systems
Your SaaS customers are asking to use your product from their AI tools
You need one integration that works across several AI clients

faqs.question: Is MCP only for Claude?
faqs.answer: No. It is an open standard supported by a growing number of AI clients and developer tools.

faqs.question: Is it safe to connect AI to internal systems?
faqs.answer: It can be, when every tool is permissioned, inputs are validated, high-impact actions need approval and all calls are logged.
